Module 01 · Inbox

Every channel in one list

Calls, emails, website enquiries, Instagram, Messenger and SMS land in one place. The AI has already written the reply — you check it and press Send. Nothing sends on its own.

Module 02 · Pipeline

Know where every job stands

New enquiry → quoted → won. Every card carries its price and its history. Drag it across as the job moves — and see what the week is actually worth.

Module 03 · AI Receptionist

Never miss another call

It answers 24/7, takes down the job details, tells you what the call was about and books the visit into your week. Time-wasters get flagged; they never get your mobile.

Module 04 · Estimator

Prices every job from your rates

Open a job and the price is already worked out — from your own rates, cross-checked against your past jobs, with the working shown.

✓Built from your rate book — never a wild guess
✓Cross-checked against your past jobs
✓You confirm the final price; it learns from each job

Module 05 · Knowledge

Your business, taught once

Your greeting, your rules, your starting prices. Every AI reply follows them — it never quotes below your floor and never promises what you cannot do.

Module 06 · Cockpit

Your day at a glance

What needs your attention, what the pipeline is worth, where the work came from and what is booked in — the whole business on one screen, before your first coffee.
